_comment: Reloaded automatically whenever this file changes — edit it while the
server is running and the next sentence picks it up.
terms: handed to Whisper as an expectation of what it's about to hear.
Use it for names, places, jargon, and regional words it mishears.
Whisper caps the prompt near 224 tokens, so a focused list of 20-60
beats an exhaustive one — a long list dilutes the bias.
replacements: applied to the translation after the fact, keyed by target
language. Use it for terms the translator renders wrongly every time,
